The line reads 'app. a co. on MantraTantra by Ananta, s/o Kamal[ā]kara, ff.1-64 inc.' A small left arrow stands at about x3125,y740, and a dash continues beyond the gutter at about x3260-3360. On fol. 183 a matching '← —' stands left of the √c.151(1) row. The candidate's link is reasonable as probable. The final vowel of the name is cursive and could be -a or -e, and this remains uncertain.

Two lines with the 'ff' before 188 struck or overwritten. A comma-like stroke stands below 'defective,' and an unreadable mark stands between 'Ś.' and '1504'. The left arrow at about x3385,y990 lies beyond the gutter and points to √c.147 on fol. 183. The words 'many of' are also visible at the facing page's left edge, so this is a gutter overlap, not a separate record. The last letters of 'Śivāditya' are not secure.

A ticked holding with an indented 'begins' line. A '+' mark sits between the lines, below the comma after the title word and above 'rahasye'. A heavy dot follows the final word of the incipit. A separate ink dot stands at about x2220,y1155. The double-headed arrow at about x3130-3300,y1053 straddles the gutter. The incipit word written with a subscript dot (Harinākṣī) is lost in the candidate.

Ticked holding √d.92(4). 'praśna' is written with superscript/subscript letters. The line ends ':27:7,10:D' followed by a left arrow, with a right arrow beyond the gutter at about x3300-3375. The line-end figures also appear at the left edge of fol. 183, which is an overlap and not a duplicate record. Whether the extent is written '(17 bis)' or '(17)bis' is unclear.
Interlinear 's/o Mahādeva Bhaṭṭa of Prayāga' in small script below 'Scribe Vaidyanātha'. It is correctly grouped with r005.

Ticked holding √d.92(5) with two 'Do.' ditto marks. A left-pointing arrow stands at about x3120-3175,y2518 and a right arrow beyond the gutter. The ditto relation to the immediately preceding d.92(4) is visible on this page.

An overflow line without a shelfmark, ending '= I.O. 2576'. A left arrow stands at about x3050-3200,y3366, and a dash beyond the gutter at about y3360. On fol. 183 a '←—' stands left of √c.148(1). The c.151(2) row there also cites I.O. 2576, so the attachment remains probable, not secure.

An overflow line without a shelfmark, ending 'I.O. 2576'. A left arrow stands beyond the gutter at about x3295-3375,y3616, beside √c.158(1) on fol. 183. The initial 'ff' has extra ink. A faint vertical speck at about x2665,y3616 is non-textual.

An overflow line without a shelfmark, ending 'Oxf. 155'. A left arrow stands at about x3080-3180,y4096, with a short dash beyond the gutter at about x3305-3335 near √c.153(2). The word after 'ff.1-16,' is ambiguous: 'inf.', 'inc.' or 'unf.'.
A small 'xx' ink mark with a dot above-left, at about x1320-1370,y3930-3945. It is unattached. Whether it is meaningful or incidental is unknown.

review.boundary_review: The gutter is at about x3225. Arrowheads and dashes for b002, b003, b005, b007, b008, b009 and b010 sit on or beyond it and are treated as attachment marks. The b003 text 'many of' and the b005 line end ':27:7,10:D' are visible on both pages. They are recorded once, on this page. Facing-page text such as 'V.S. Chānd...' at about y2070 and the partial ticks below it belong to fol. 183 and are not transcribed.

region_review.top: The folio number 182b is at top left. There is no other text above b002.
region_review.middle: Between b004 and b005 (y about 1160-2370) there are only specks and offset traces. Between b007 and b008 there are offset traces and dots only, with no text.
region_review.bottom: b010 is followed by blank ruled lines to the page edge at about y4830. Only faint offset from fol. 183 is present. This is an image-reviewed finding.
region_review.left_margin: The ticks before d.367(5), d.92(4) and d.92(5) are noted. A smudge stands below d.92(5). There are no other marginal notes.
region_review.right_margin: Arrows stand near the gutter on the rows of b002, b004, b005, b007, b008 and b010. The b003 and b009 arrows lie beyond the gutter. All are noted in their records.
region_review.interlinear: b006 stands below the scribe name and the '+' mark in b004 between its lines. The comma below 'defective' in b003 is noted. No other interlinear writing was found.
